type: extension (post-Gate-B, from CANDIDATE_SELECTION_AUDIT.md; user authorised justified additions 2026-10-30)
rationale: The scientific-domain embedding family is absent from RQ3-v2; SPECTER2 was only tested under a superseded protocol and is not in the thesis table.
model: allenai/specter2_base (110M, Apache-2.0) + adapters per the model card for ad-hoc search: queries allenai/specter2_adhoc_query, passages allenai/specter2 (proximity). [CLS] of last hidden state, L2-normalised, max_length 512.
pipeline: Identical to RQ3-v2 (pymupdf_layout -> hierarchical children -> dense ranking -> production context assembly).
comparison: SPECTER2 vs the e5-small-v2 rows produced by RQ3-v2 on the same papers and questions; single separate test (not added to the frozen Holm m=4 family).
primary: budgeted nDCG@10, paper-cluster paired bootstrap B=10,000 seed 42
decision_rule: The frozen RQ3 rule: switch only if diff >= +0.04, CI lower bound > 0 and P50 query latency <= 1.5x e5.
efficiency: indexing chunks/s (batch 32), query latency P50/P95 (110 queries, 10 warm-up), peak working set (own process)
caveat: SPECTER2 was trained for paper-level similarity; the ad-hoc query adapter targets paper search, not passage QA.
precision_rule: Planned CI half-width as RQ3 (0.035). If observed is larger: report and propose, do not expand.
